cards.definition: Request information about an alarm or the current alarm configuration.
includes: List, confirm, or inspect an existing alarm and its time or description.
excludes: Creating an alarm or deleting/disabling an alarm; inspecting calendar appointments.

cards.definition: Request cancellation, deletion, or disabling of an alarm.
includes: Remove one alarm, a recurring alarm, or all alarms.
excludes: Only checking alarms; turning off room lighting or audio output.

cards.definition: Request creation or scheduling of an alarm notification.
includes: Set an alarm at a time, after a delay, or on a condition.
excludes: Only checking or cancelling alarms; scheduling an appointment without alarm intent.

cards.definition: Request a decrease in the loudness of audio output.
includes: Make speakers or playback quieter, including a lower target level.
excludes: Complete muting; unspecified adjustment with no recoverable decrease; dimming lights.

cards.definition: Request suppression of audible output or silence.
includes: Mute, sound off, or set volume to zero.
excludes: Merely lowering to a nonzero level; cancelling an alarm rather than silencing output.

cards.definition: Request inspection or adjustment of audio volume without a resolved increase, decrease, or mute operation.
includes: Open volume controls or request an unspecified volume change.
excludes: A clearly specified increase, decrease, or complete mute.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Directional decrease wording appears in other; precedence needs review.

cards.definition: Request an increase in the loudness of audio output.
includes: Make speakers or playback louder, including a higher target level.
excludes: Light brightness increase; unspecified volume change; playback speed change.

unresolved_evidence.finding: The isolated word slow does not establish a volume increase.

cards.definition: Request information about personal calendar events, reminders, or schedule availability.
includes: Inspect appointments, existing reminders, free time, or event details.
excludes: Create/delete events; discover public events; request the current clock time alone.

cards.definition: Request deletion or cancellation of a calendar event or reminder.
includes: Remove an appointment, scheduled reminder, or a set of calendar events.
excludes: Only inspect a schedule; delete an alarm or list item without calendar intent.

cards.definition: Request creation, scheduling, or repetition of a calendar event or reminder.
includes: Add an appointment, recurring event, or scheduled reminder.
excludes: Only retrieve a schedule or list; set a wake-up alarm without calendar intent.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Retrieve-today-list wording conflicts with the proposed creation operation.

cards.definition: Candidate cooking-information category whose distinction from cooking_recipe is unresolved in admitted learning evidence.
includes: Cooking questions represented by the two retained learning source utterances.
excludes: No verified exclusive boundary with recipe requests or ingredient substitutions yet.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Only two source utterances; recipe and substitution requests overlap cooking_recipe.

cards.definition: Request a recipe or practical food preparation guidance.
includes: Cooking instructions, recipe selection, and ingredient substitutions seen in learning evidence.
excludes: Ordering prepared food or asking for restaurant recommendations; overlap with cooking_query remains unresolved.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Ingredient substitution overlaps the only cooking_query evidence; no validated exclusive boundary.

cards.definition: Request conversion between time zones or a change of time-zone setting.
includes: Compare times across locations, compute a time difference, or change configured time zone.
excludes: Only ask a date, weekday, or current time; currency conversion.

cards.definition: Request a date, clock time, weekday, or calendar-date fact.
includes: Ask what time/day it is or which weekday a date falls on.
excludes: Inspect personal appointments; convert between time zones; ask weather for a date.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Isolated ordinal wording is insufficient to establish a date/time request.

cards.definition: Request creation or modification of a contact entry containing contact information.
includes: Add an email address to contacts or change a stored contact address.
excludes: Only retrieve contact details; send a message to the contact.

cards.definition: Request retrieval or inspection of email messages or mailbox state.
includes: Read an email, check unread messages, or inspect received mail.
excludes: Send/reply to mail; inspect address-book data rather than messages.

cards.definition: Request retrieval of information about a stored contact.
includes: Look up an address, personal detail, or contact entry.
excludes: Create/edit a contact; retrieve email message contents; ask public facts about a person.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Adding a favorite contact is an apparent modification, not retrieval.

cards.definition: Request composition, sending, or replying to an email.
includes: Send mail to a recipient or reply with specified content.
excludes: Only read received mail; publish a social-network post.

cards.definition: Perform a greeting or a conventional social check-in with the assistant.
includes: Hello, good morning, or a conventional how-are-you greeting.
excludes: Request a joke or substantive assistant-persona conversation; greeting/quirky overlap needs review.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Conventional how-are-you wording overlaps general_quirky persona conversation.

cards.definition: Request that the assistant tell a joke or provide humorous material.
includes: Ask for a joke generally or about a topic.
excludes: A general greeting or conversation without a request for humor.

cards.definition: Dataset-specific miscellaneous conversational category with a not-yet-verified closed boundary.
includes: Assistant-persona conversation and miscellaneous utterances represented in learning data.
excludes: Not a validated out-of-domain catch-all; overlaps with greetings and factual questions require review.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Heterogeneous fragments and assistant feelings; neither a complete semantic class nor validated OOD policy.

cards.definition: Request operation of a robot cleaner or assistance concerning that cleaning device.
includes: Start a vacuum or ask about its operation, as represented in learning evidence.
excludes: Generic smart-plug switching or unrelated cleaning advice without device context.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Operational question rather than activation; action-only semantics would exclude existing learning evidence.

cards.definition: Request operation of a coffee maker or preparation of coffee by that device.
includes: Start brewing now or schedule coffee preparation.
excludes: Ask a cooking recipe, order cafe delivery, or switch an unrelated appliance.

cards.definition: Request a change in lighting color or color mode.
includes: Set a light color or cycle through colors.
excludes: Only increase/decrease brightness or switch lighting on/off.

cards.definition: Request reduced lighting brightness while retaining illumination.
includes: Dim lights or lower their brightness to a specified level.
excludes: Completely turn lights off; change color alone; decrease audio volume.

cards.definition: Request that lighting be switched off.
includes: Turn off a room light or all lights; indirect requests require sufficient evidence.
excludes: Only dim lighting; switch an identified smart plug rather than lighting.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Sleep statement requires inferred lighting action not explicit in reference text.

cards.definition: Request that lighting be switched on.
includes: Activate lights; indirect darkness complaints require an admitted interpretation.
excludes: Increase already active lighting brightness; turn on an identified smart plug.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Indirect darkness and high-setting requests blur activation versus brightness increase.

cards.definition: Request increased lighting brightness.
includes: Brighten lights or increase illumination intensity.
excludes: Only activate lighting without a brightness change; raise audio volume.

cards.definition: Request deactivation of a smart plug or its controlled power supply.
includes: Switch off a Wemo socket or smart outlet.
excludes: A lighting-only request with no plug-control evidence; conflicting on/off wording remains unresolved.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Both off and on occur; unresolved intended polarity.

cards.definition: Request activation of a smart plug or its controlled power supply.
includes: Switch on a Wemo socket or smart outlet.
excludes: A lighting-only request; an arbitrary appliance command without evidence of plug control.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Advice and laundry command do not explicitly establish smart-plug activation.

cards.definition: Request creation of a list or addition of items to a list.
includes: Create a shopping/to-do list or append an item to an existing list.
excludes: Only read/delete list content; place a commercial order without list intent.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Grocery-order wording lacks explicit list creation/addition.

cards.definition: Request retrieval or inspection of lists or their contents.
includes: List available lists, read remaining tasks, or inspect item order.
excludes: Add/remove list content; inspect calendar events rather than list items.

cards.definition: Request deletion of a list or removal of an item from a list.
includes: Delete a shopping list or remove one listed task/item.
excludes: Only inspect lists; cancel an appointment rather than remove a list entry.

cards.definition: Express or register a negative preference about music.
includes: Dislike a song/artist or request that disliked music not be selected again.
excludes: Merely reduce loudness or change playback mode without a negative preference.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Object of dislike requires context absent from isolated reference.

cards.definition: Express or register a positive preference about music.
includes: Like a song/artist, mark a favorite, or give positive musical feedback.
excludes: Only request playback/repetition without preference evidence.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Positive preference and repeat command co-occur; primary-intent precedence unresolved.

cards.definition: Request information about music or listening history.
includes: Identify a song/writer or ask about music characteristics or prior listening.
excludes: Start playback, change settings, or express preference without an information request.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Fragment or music discovery request; informational boundary needs review.

cards.definition: Request a music playback mode or sound-setting change.
includes: Enable shuffle/repeat or change equalizer mode.
excludes: Select content for playback; change volume alone; preference registration alone.

cards.definition: Request news, current reporting, or updates on developing events.
includes: Read headlines, news from a source, or updates on a topic.
excludes: Retrieve a social feed, recommend events, or answer a non-news factual question.

cards.definition: Request playback or navigation of an audiobook.
includes: Start/resume a spoken book or change its playback position.
excludes: Play music, podcasts, radio, or ask a fact about a book without playback intent.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Song/audiobook mixed cues and underspecified title require review.

cards.definition: Request starting or participating in a game.
includes: Open a game, play an interactive game, or initiate a game turn.
excludes: Play media content or ask factual information about a game.

cards.definition: Request selection, starting, or navigation of music playback.
includes: Play a song/artist/playlist or select the next music item.
excludes: Only identify a song, register a preference, or change a playback mode.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Platform name alone does not uniquely specify the requested operation.

cards.definition: Request playback or episode navigation of a podcast.
includes: Start a podcast, resume it, or select another episode.
excludes: Play an audiobook, song, or radio station; generic navigation needs context.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Episode navigation or go back lacks a reliable media type in isolated reference.

cards.definition: Request playback or selection of a radio station or radio program.
includes: Turn on radio, tune a station, or select a station-based stream.
excludes: Select a particular song/podcast without station intent.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Todays hits may refer to songs or a station; no explicit station cue.

cards.definition: Request a currency exchange rate or conversion between currencies.
includes: Look up an exchange rate or convert a monetary amount.
excludes: Ask stock prices; arithmetic without currency exchange; time-zone conversion.

cards.definition: Request the meaning, definition, or descriptive explanation of a term or concept.
includes: Define a word or explain what a named concept is.
excludes: Ask a specific factual attribute without a definitional purpose; broad descriptions may overlap.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Description of a landmark overlaps general factoid interpretation.

cards.definition: Request general factual information outside more specific registered domains.
includes: Ask who/where/when or factual attributes of public people, places, or objects.
excludes: Definitions, arithmetic, finance, weather, news, or personal contact lookup when those purposes are explicit.

cards.definition: Request arithmetic computation or a mathematical answer.
includes: Compute a numeric operation or solve an arithmetic question.
excludes: Currency exchange or stock quote requests; numerical wording alone is insufficient.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Incomplete expression or declarative equation; information request may be underdetermined.

cards.definition: Request stock prices, market quotes, or stock-market information.
includes: Ask a share price, index/futures quote, or market outlook.
excludes: Currency exchange or general business news without stock-market intent.

cards.definition: Request discovery or recommendations of public events or activities.
includes: Find concerts, activities, or events in a location/time window.
excludes: Inspect personal appointments; recommend a venue alone or a movie.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Public events wording overlaps calendar domain if personal/public scope is not fixed.

cards.definition: Request discovery or recommendations of places or venues to visit.
includes: Find a restaurant, shop, hotel, or other suitable local place.
excludes: Track/order takeaway; query scheduled public events or film selections.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Venue discovery and factual superlative can overlap factoid semantics.

cards.definition: Request movie recommendations or information about available screenings.
includes: Suggest a film or find movies currently showing nearby.
excludes: Start non-film media playback; generic venue or public-event discovery.

cards.definition: Request publication of content on a social platform.
includes: Post a status, tweet, or public review.
excludes: Read social activity/messages; send an email.

cards.definition: Request retrieval or monitoring of social-platform activity.
includes: Check posts, likes, replies, or social-network messages.
excludes: Publish content; inspect email; retrieve general news without social-platform intent.

cards.definition: Request placing an order for prepared food delivery or takeaway.
includes: Order a meal or initiate a takeaway purchase.
excludes: Only inspect delivery availability/status or recommend a restaurant.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Nearby pizza shops does not establish an order request.

cards.definition: Request information about takeaway service or an existing food order.
includes: Check delivery availability, delivery options, order status, or arrival time.
excludes: Place a new food order; ask general venue recommendations.

cards.definition: Request transport schedules, routes, availability, or travel options.
includes: Inspect train times or transport availability without a resolved purchase request.
excludes: Book/buy tickets, hire a taxi, or ask road-traffic conditions; query/ticket boundary needs review.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Ticket request wording overlaps transport_ticket.

cards.definition: Request arranging or booking a taxi or ride-hailing service.
includes: Hail a cab or book a ride with pickup/destination/time details.
excludes: Buy a public-transport ticket or merely query general travel options.

cards.definition: Request purchase or booking of a transport ticket.
includes: Reserve or buy train tickets with route, passenger, or time constraints.
excludes: Only inspect schedules/availability; hire a taxi; query/ticket overlap needs review.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Route search and explicit schedule question overlap transport_query.

cards.definition: Request road-traffic conditions or driving delay information.
includes: Check congestion, road conditions, or traffic-dependent journey time.
excludes: Inspect public-transport timetables, purchase tickets, or book a taxi.

cards.definition: Request weather conditions, forecasts, or weather-dependent practical advice.
includes: Ask about rain, temperature, a forecast, or clothing suitability given weather.
excludes: Ask the time/date alone or non-weather factual information.

unresolved_evidence.finding: Evening alone does not establish a weather query.

scope: 60 candidate semantic cards, not finalized ontology or a relabelled dataset. Listed contradictions are triage findings, not verified annotation errors. No issue entry does not certify the class.
